0x0008F7.en: 「Not with the power I have now...@　This is as far as I go...!」

0x0009F0.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000B19.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x000C1A.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000C55.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000CA9.en: 「Blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000DFA.en: 「This is it...... The rest is up to you.」

0x000EA6.en: 「No good, took too much damage...... Retreating!」

0x000EF3.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I leave the rest to you.」

0x000F31.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F78.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x001023.en: 「Guh... So I'm the falling star... Ejecting!」

0x0010DA.en: 「Ow ow ow... You got me. Miscalculation.」

0x00115F.en: 「Hnn... urgh! So this is my limit...!」

0x0011CC.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001213.en: 「Sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001248.en: 「Damn it! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001305.en: 「Heh... You're as good as they say.」

0x001334.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I still have so far to go...!」

0x001382.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x00143D.en: 「Sorry, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x00146C.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0014AA.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0014D9.en: 「I'm afraid I can go no further. Allow me to take my leave.」

0x001564.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001788.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018F7.en: 「So I still have far to go too...!」

0x001958.en: 「A-all hands!@ Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x00199A.en: 「Aw no, they went and got me.」

0x0019CC.en: 「Guess I've got no choice but to fall back...!」

0x001A47.en: Earth Federation Government Press Conference Broadcast

0x001A79.en: 「...Regarding the hostile entities that emerged@ from the Antarctic, as of today they have been@ officially designated 'Ruina.'」

0x001B0C.en: 「Ruina had massed forces in the Arctic Ocean, but the Gaia Sabers and Earth Federation Army jointly carried out an encirclement...」

0x001BBD.en: 「The Gaia Sabers' flagship Air Christmas destroyed the enemy's main force. Also, the barrier covering the whole Earth...」

0x001C5C.en: 「It was found to belong not to the Guests but to@ Ruina... and we have succeeded in removing it.」

0x001CD6.en: 「Going forward, against Ruina, which occupies the@　Antarctic region, and against the Guests as well,@　we intend to pursue swift and effective countermeasures...」

0x001D66.en: Earth Federation Army Joint Chiefs of Staff

0x001D98.en: 「...They're trumpeting the Gaia Sabers' feats for@ all they're worth. Meant to deflect blame for@ President Grusman's death, no doubt.」

0x001E7A.en: 「No choice about it.@ We can hardly call the ones who erased the@ dimensional fault traitors ourselves.」

0x001F0B.en: 「By the way, you passed the name 'Ruina'@ along to government channels?」

0x001F6A.en: 「The codename 'Antarctic Unknown' had no@ style to it, no? And it was too long.」

0x001FF6.en: 「Indeed. And the source of the information?」

0x00202A.en: 「I said nothing.@ It would expose our hand.」

0x00207A.en: 「Also, thanks to intel they provided, we've@ identified several Gaia Sabers members. Here@ are the documents.」

0x00215F.en: 「Recruiting former anti-establishment figures...@ Perfect ammunition for the opposition.」

0x0021EE.en: 「They likely value ability over past record...@ but even if pressed, they'll play dumb.」

0x002277.en: 「Before that, it's doubtful President Graien@ even knew about this.」

0x0022EE.en: 「Surely he didn't authorize it without knowing...」

0x002325.en: 「It's possible Alteur Steinbeck simply@ never told him the truth.」

0x00239C.en: 「Still, between the President's death and this affair, solid proof would collapse not just the Sabers but the whole government.」

0x002468.en: 「That's why Alteur's aim eludes me. He gives no thought to the future... If anything, he seems to be sowing trouble on purpose.」

0x00255F.en: 「I can't say yet, but there's a way to find the answer.」

0x0025CA.en: 「Yes. There's no doubt the Gaia Sabers are using@ them, scheming toward something.」

0x002641.en: 「Let them run a while longer and make contact,@ and Alteur's scheme may come into view.」

0x0026B5.en: 「But we can't openly support the@ Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x00270E.en: 「Of course I've no intention of rescinding the@ pursuit order. But, Jacob... leave them a way out.」

0x0027B3.en: 「Is that all we'll do about@ the Gaia Sabers?」

0x002812.en: 「Most of the public believes the Gaia Sabers@ erased the dimensional fault, and they're coming@ to see them as heroes.」

0x0028AB.en: 「No help for it right now.@ There's no battle record more clear-cut, nor one@ you can show to every human on Earth.」

0x00293B.en: 「But heroes must always deliver results. If there's falsehood in it, feelings toward them will flip in an instant.」

0x002A26.en: 「It's not as if we're doing nothing.@ I've had Jacob gathering intel and evidence.」

0x002A94.en: 「Besides, however great the Gaia Sabers' feats,@ we vastly outnumber them.」

0x002B1D.en: 「What matters is staying power.@ A handful of specialized independent forces may@ crush the enemy's core, but...」

0x002BB0.en: 「Maintaining security on a global scale is impossible.」

0x002C1B.en: 「Restore the Army's honor - build a Guest counteroffensive now. With Moon Cradle and Heaven's Gate lost, the Space Army won't hold.」

0x002CF9.en: 「Understood.@ I'll have an operation outline ready within a day or two.」

0x002D55.en: 「I have a good idea for the operation name.@ Don't go deciding it on your own.」

0x002E47.en: 「A renowned robotics researcher.@ An acquaintance of Bian Zoldark's, with a history@ in the <EOTI Agency>.」

0x002EF7.en: 「Though he seems to have@ withdrawn from the front lines now...」

0x002F54.en: 「That's the public story.@ He's involved in developing the@ Compatible Kaiser.」

0x002FEB.en: 「That machine displayed intriguing abilities in@ the Balmar incident and the Shura rebellion.」

0x003068.en: 「There's no mistake that <EOT> is used in the@ Compatible Kaiser. And I believe it's hidden@ underground in the Asakusa district of Japan.」

0x003139.en: 「And so... what do you intend to do?」

0x00316D.en: 「To seize the Compatible Kaiser and its EOT, I'd like permission to deploy the Delta Saber. It would let my machine evolve further.」

0x00324E.en: 「Use the Jinrai in an urban area?@ Are you sane, Dr. Tomine?」

0x0032A7.en: 「All who side with the Steel Dragon Squadron@ are traitors... As long as we have a pretext, it won't be a problem.」

0x00332B.en: 「Have you forgotten who altered Archin's AI?」

0x003377.en: (Is that meant to be a threat...?)

0x0033A5.en: 「I'd also like your permission to use that.」

0x0033DF.en: 「The risk is too high.@ Besides, it's not as if you actually intend to obtain Dr. Azuma's@ research results at all...」

0x003463.en: 「You just want to destroy a machine that could rival@ the Jinrai with the Jinrai, to prove its superiority?」

0x0034F9.en: 「To begin with, I hardly think the Jinrai is the right@ choice for seizing the Compatible Kaiser.」

0x00358C.en: 「...Very well, Dr. Tomine.@ I'll accept your proposal.」

0x0035E5.en: 「Thank you, Commander.@ The Jinrai is currently under adjustment, so@ I'll deploy the mass-production models.」

0x003666.en: 「Ah, that makes for better risk hedging too.」

0x0036A9.en: 「Then I'll set to preparations at once.」

0x0036E3.en: 「...Are you certain about this, Lord Alteur?」

0x003720.en: 「Had it not been in the Far East Army's@ jurisdiction, I'd not have permitted it.」

0x003776.en: 「But if it goes badly, it could hand@ the opposition a pretext.」

0x0037E1.en: 「To make sure it doesn't, have Kenneth smooth things over.@ It may even lure out the Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x00385E.en: 「But Dr. Tomine seems to be dimly aware of the truth@ behind that matter. Should he, by any chance,@ act as Dr. Ozunu did...」

0x00390C.en: 「He's more the same breed as Mitarl Zapad@ or Erde Mitte. He won't be troubled@ by pangs of conscience.」

0x0039A2.en: 「As long as we pave the road to his goal for him,@ he won't do anything so treacherous...」

0x003A4F.en: 「...Your marksmanship is nearing a passing grade, but your melee has many flaws. You rely too much on the TD scale.」

0x003AE8.en: 「Sharpen your feel for the machine, and learn to@ grasp the range to the enemy with your skin.」

0x003B44.en: 「Skin, huh... In a sense, that's the DFC.」

0x003BAC.en: 「The DFC I use is a lot like working@　levers and jog dials with your fingertips,@　making tiny, precise adjustments......」

0x003C78.en: 「It reads your skin and muscle movements too......@ Like hugging a balance ball to keep steady,@ controlling output bit by bit.」

0x003D8B.en: 「......Ensign Hugo, Ensign Aqua,@　the two of you are running simulator training?」

0x003E24.en: 「But Ensign Aqua, aren't you an operator......?」

0x003E5E.en: 「I originally trained to be a <PT> pilot......@ so I figured I should learn to pilot one myself,@ just in case anything happens.」

0x003F36.en: （Now that we know the Zentr Project@　falls under Gaia Sabers' jurisdiction,@　I can't go to Mitarl to get the medicine.）

0x003FF3.en: （Whether the supply runs dry first,@　or the Gaia Sabers matter gets settled first......@　either way, I need to finish Aqua quickly.）

0x0040AA.en: 「By the way, Ariel......@　are you here for simulator training too?」

0x004106.en: 「No, Dr. Radom called me@　out here, actually......」

0x0041A6.en: 「Dr. Radom......@　and Lieutenant Kyosuke and Ensign Excellen too.」

0x00426B.en: 「I don't much care for the fact that your Alteisen Riese@　and the Flickerei Geist use an EOT@　called the Vau Kern......」

0x00432E.en: 「But those two machines have something in common@　when it comes to main-weapon operation.」

0x00CD3A.en: （To think she's the one who developed Jinrai...）

0x00CD74.en: （Never knew Dr. Tomine had a daughter...）

0x00CDB1.en: 「I'm so sorry...@ Because of me and my father... all this trouble...」
